verdict.rationale: Grok Build offers in-session scheduling: `/loop` reruns a prompt on a recurring interval (e.g. checking every 5m whether tests pass), and background monitors watch logs, CI runs or ports. Headless mode (`-p`, JSON output) and ACP let users wire it into their own scripts or bots, and Auto mode auto-approves safe tools. However, these features run inside a live session or rely on user-built automation, not a managed always-on agent service. Missing for 10: persistent/hosted always-on agents independent of an open session, native cron or event triggers (e.g. CI failure, new issue/PR), documented autonomous fix-and-PR workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended operation.
